headline: Council reviewed plans for a new transit department head and a rental car facility fee at the airport.
summary: The city plans to make the Community Connector transit system a standalone department under a full-time department head, with pay starting in the low $100,000s. A rental car fee at the airport has collected about $1.9 million toward a consolidated rental car facility that could cost $20-30 million. Council also recognized City Solicitor Dave Sauerzapf on his last day with the city.
discussion: Transit department head: Council asked whether ridership is rising or falling. Staff said ridership has grown steadily since the pandemic but has stayed relatively flat, and that reliable service is needed to bring riders back.

Transit position cost: The position would be on the executive pay scale, starting in the low $100,000s and rising to about $150,000. The city would use up to $65,000 from its unassigned fund balance to cover the cost.
Assistant city manager duties: Members discussed how the transit duties would move to the city manager's office when the assistant city manager leaves, and how the city is recruiting for that role.
Rental car facility funding: Staff said the facility would be self-sustaining, paid for by customer fees, and that this appropriation covers planning before design and construction.
Comparable airports: Staff named Portland and Manchester, New Hampshire, as airports with similar fee programs, and Myrtle Beach as one with similar seasonal demand.
